rule.description: GitHub Actions workflow 配置应遵循最小权限原则，只保留当前需要的权限；stale issue 等自动化提示文案应清晰准确，告知用户具体操作方式。
checkpoints: workflow 的 permissions 是否只包含必要的权限
是否在暂不支持某功能时移除了相关权限
stale 提示文案是否清晰说明了自动关闭的时间和处理方式
是否移除了不必要的 repo_token

antipattern.code:
name: "Close stale resolved/wait-feedback issues"
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 6,14,22 * * *'
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]

jobs:
  remove-wait-feedback-on-comment:
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'issue_comment' && contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'wait-feedback') }}
    runs-on: linux-amd64-cpu-2-hk
    permissions:
      issues: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Install system dependencies
        run: |
      - run: gh issue edit "${{ github.event.issue.number }}" --remove-label "wait-feedback" --repo "${{ github.repository }}"
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
  stale:
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'schedule' }}
    runs-on: linux-amd64-cpu-2-hk
    steps:
      - uses: actions/stale@v10
        with:
          any-of-labels: 'resolved'
          operations-per-run: 1000
          days-before-stale: 7
          stale-issue-label: 'stale'
          stale-issue-message: |
            This issue has been marked as `resolved` but has not received any feedback for some time, so it is now labeled as `stale`.
            If you feel this was a mistake, please leave a comment to remove the `stale` label.
            `Stale` issues will automatically be closed after some days of inactivity.
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          days-before-close: 14
antipattern.context: zeshengzong 建议修改 stale 提示文案，使措辞更准确。
